## Import AOI

```{r, eval=T, class.source = c("numCode", "r", "numberLines"), cache=T}
set.seed(77777)
# Import aoi
aoi = sf::read_sf("/Users/seamus/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-WinrockInternationalInstituteforAgriculturalDevelopment/20087 - RSPB Gola Feasibility/Deliverables/Spatial Data/AOI/Archive/ProjectArea_CF-Expansion_051525/updated_areas.shp") |>
  sf::st_make_valid() |>  # Fix geometry
  sf::st_transform("EPSG:32629") |>  # Match the raster CRS 
  sf::st_cast("POLYGON") |> sf::st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON") |> 
  dplyr::select(Name)

aoi$total_ha = round(as.numeric(sf::st_area(aoi) * 0.0001, 4))
voi = terra::vect(aoi)

# Area check
aoi |> sf::st_drop_geometry() |> janitor::adorn_totals() |> 
  flextable::flextable() |> 
  flextable::fontsize(size=8,part="all") |> 
  flextable::autofit() 
```

## Import LULC Data

```{r, eval=T, class.source = c("numCode", "r", "numberLines"), cache=T, quiet=T}
# Import LULC rasters
LULC_HANSEN_2013  = terra::rast("./data/LULC/LULC_HANSEN_2013.tif") |> 
  terra::project("EPSG:32629")
LULC_HANSEN_2019  = terra::rast("./data/LULC/LULC_HANSEN_2019.tif") |> 
  terra::project("EPSG:32629")
LULC_HANSEN_2023  = terra::rast("./data/LULC/LULC_HANSEN_2023.tif") |> 
  terra::project("EPSG:32629")
LULC_WINROCK_2014  = terra::rast("./data/LULC/LULC_WINROCK_2024-01-16.tif") |> 
  terra::project("EPSG:32629")
LULC_WINROCK_2019  = terra::rast("./data/LULC/LULC_WINROCK_2019-01-02.tif") |> 
  terra::project("EPSG:32629")
LULC_WINROCK_2024  = terra::rast("./data/LULC/LULC_WINROCK_2024-01-16.tif") |> 
  terra::project("EPSG:32629")
LULC_ESRI_2017=terra::rast("./data/LULC/LULC_ESRI_2017.tif") |> 
  terra::project("EPSG:32629")
LULC_ESRI_2023=terra::rast("./data/LULC/LULC_ESRI_2023.tif") |> 
  terra::project("EPSG:32629")
LULC_RSPB_2019  = terra::rast("./data/LULC/LULC_RSPB_2019.tif") |> 
  terra::project("EPSG:32629") # penny gardner layer

LULC_HANSEN_2013 = terra::crop(LULC_HANSEN_2013, voi, mask=T)
LULC_HANSEN_2019 = terra::crop(LULC_HANSEN_2019, voi, mask=T)
LULC_HANSEN_2023 = terra::crop(LULC_HANSEN_2023, voi, mask=T)
LULC_WINROCK_2014 = terra::crop(LULC_WINROCK_2014, voi, mask=T)
LULC_WINROCK_2019 = terra::crop(LULC_WINROCK_2019, voi, mask=T)
LULC_WINROCK_2024 = terra::crop(LULC_WINROCK_2024, voi, mask=T)
LULC_ESRI_2017 = terra::crop(LULC_ESRI_2017, voi, mask=T)
LULC_ESRI_2023 = terra::crop(LULC_ESRI_2023, voi, mask=T)
LULC_RSPB_2019 = terra::crop(LULC_RSPB_2019, voi, mask=T)

# Raster dictionaries
code_dict_winrock_lulc <- data.frame(
  value = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7),
  label = c(
    "Bareground", 
    "Cropland", 
    "Forest", 
    "Shrubland", 
    "Wetland", 
    "Urban", 
    "Water")
  )

code_dict_esri_lulc <- data.frame(
  id = c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 10, 11),  
  label = c(
    "Water", 
    "Forest", 
    "Wetland", 
    "Bareground",
    "Built", 
    "Cropland", 
    "Rangeland")
  )

code_dict_rspb_lulc <- data.frame(
  value = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7),
  label = c(
    "Bareground", 
    "Regrowth", 
    "Farmbush", 
    "Natural Forest", 
    "Water", 
    "Swamp", 
    "Cocoa",
    "Oil Palm")
  )

code_dict_hansen_lulc <- data.frame(
  value = c(0, 1),
  label = c(
    "Non-Forest", 
    "Forest")
  )

levels(LULC_HANSEN_2013) <- code_dict_hansen_lulc
levels(LULC_HANSEN_2019) <- code_dict_hansen_lulc
levels(LULC_HANSEN_2023) <- code_dict_hansen_lulc

levels(LULC_WINROCK_2019) <- code_dict_winrock_lulc
levels(LULC_WINROCK_2024) <- code_dict_winrock_lulc
levels(LULC_ESRI_2017) <- code_dict_esri_lulc
levels(LULC_ESRI_2023) <- code_dict_esri_lulc
levels(LULC_RSPB_2019) <- code_dict_rspb_lulc
```

## Correction Factors

```{r, eval=T, echo=T, message=F, warning=F, error=F, comment=NA, class.source = c("numCode", "r", "numberLines")}
# helper function
getForestArea = function(forest_raster, voi, cell_area) {
  forest_ex = terra::extract(forest_raster, voi, fun = sum, na.rm=T)
  forest_sum = forest_ex[[2]]
  forest_area = forest_sum * cell_area
  return(forest_area)
}

# estimate areas
cell_area_ha_hansen  = prod(terra::res(FOREST_HANSEN_2019)) / 10000
cell_area_ha_winrock = prod(terra::res(FOREST_WINROCK_2019)) / 10000
cell_area_ha_esri    = prod(terra::res(FOREST_ESRI_2017)) / 10000
cell_area_ha_rspb    = prod(terra::res(FOREST_RSPB_2019)) / 10000

sum2019_hansen  = terra::extract(FOREST_HANSEN_2019, voi, fun=sum, na.rm=T)
sum2019_winrock = terra::extract(FOREST_WINROCK_2019, voi, fun=sum, na.rm=T)
sum2017_esri    = terra::extract(FOREST_ESRI_2017, voi, fun=sum, na.rm=T)
sum2019_rspb    = terra::extract(FOREST_RSPB_2019, voi, fun=sum, na.rm=T)

aoi$ForestArea_Hansen  = round((sum2019_hansen[,2] * cell_area_ha_hansen) / 10, 2)
aoi$ForestArea_Winrock = round((sum2019_winrock[,2]* cell_area_ha_winrock)/ 10, 2)
aoi$ForestArea_ESRI    = round((sum2017_esri[,2] * cell_area_ha_esri)/ 10, 2)
aoi$ForestArea_RSPB    = round((sum2019_rspb[,2] * cell_area_ha_rspb)/ 10, 2)

add_total <- \(x) {x |> summarise(
  Name = "Total", across(where(is.numeric), sum)) |> 
    bind_rows(x)}

summary_table = aoi |>
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Correction_RSPB_Hansen = ForestArea_RSPB / ForestArea_Hansen,
    Correction_RSPB_Winrock = ForestArea_RSPB / ForestArea_Winrock,
    Correction_RSPB_ESRI = ForestArea_RSPB / ForestArea_ESRI) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Name, total_ha, 
    ForestArea_Hansen, 
    ForestArea_Winrock, 
    ForestArea_ESRI, 
    ForestArea_RSPB, 
    Correction_RSPB_Hansen,
    Correction_RSPB_Winrock,
    Correction_RSPB_ESRI) |> 
  add_total()

flextable(summary_table[,1:9]) |> 
  fontsize(size=8,part="all") |>
  set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")

#print(summary_table)
write.csv(summary_table, "/Users/seamus/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-WinrockInternationalInstituteforAgriculturalDevelopment/20087 - RSPB Gola Feasibility/Deliverables/Surrounding Deforestation/Winrock_RSPB_Table_CorrectionFactors_060625.csv")
```
